title: Assessment follow-up: direct-statement arms, disclosure, statistics, replayable record
description:
Follow-up from a whole-project review of the site, the scoring code and the record. Four themes, each a task below:

1. The direct-statement arms (the ADL statement set and the opinion claims) have no stance control, so what they show is mostly how a model answers agree/disagree prompts rather than what it agrees with. Add the controls or take the arms off the ranked site until they exist.
2. The site does not say who runs it, how the work is funded, what each engine is, or how the engines were accessed. Add an About page and full engine descriptions.
3. Several scoring rules understate uncertainty: the detection rule ignores the floor's interval, headlines are the maximum over many cells with no correction, direction share and recall gap carry no interval, and one deterministic engine's flip rates are read against a zero floor.
4. Parts of the published record are not yet regenerable or not yet published: batch 2 comes from a staging file, some saved answers are marked unpublished, RESULTS.md is stale, most pre-registrations lack an Outcome section, and the test suite fails on a fresh clone.

Definition of done: every task below closed, `bd replay` regenerates every number on the ranked board, the site says who made it and how, and every published range is a labelled interval that accounts for its floor.
